decision: Withdraw signal_slots16_v1 as a performance candidate before device submission; retain production 512B spacing

facts.fact: MTE2, MTE3 and Scalar GM requests use a 512-byte address granularity; concurrent addresses in the same aligned region can serialize
Scalar data cache uses 64-byte lines; generic L2 line sizes vary by hardware
Scalar reads DCache then L2/GM; MTE2 reads through L2. Thus 512B concern also applies to Scalar traffic

facts.kind: A5 user-supplied empirical guide, not an A3 measurement
facts.fact: 64B line ownership, dirty DCCI writeback and separate control/data; platform-specific atomic and DSB observations require matching evidence

inference: 64B private slots do not share a Scalar DCache line, but eight slots share a 512B GM request region; smaller allocation alone is not evidence of lower synchronization cost
not_proven: Exact A3 L2 physical line size from the cited generic architecture page
Current A3 TNOTIFY protocol incorrect because an A5 guide uses a stronger conservative policy
A5 atomic/DSB exceptions portable to A3

local_path_audit.current_set: volatile GM store with signal-line DCCI before/after and DSB_DDR
local_path_audit.current_wait: DCCI and Scalar load; existing backoff 150 retained
local_path_audit.entire_cache_maintenance: Existing phase helpers retained; no deletion based on A5 conclusions

experimental_cpu.stress_error: Probe implementation reassigns INT32 errors with INDEX after errors + 1; parser rejection, no device run, not treated as a confirmed SDK bug

next_action: Keep 512B and audit actual publish/acquire operations against data owners and pipeline completions before designing a different candidate
